judgments.reason: The focal text asserts a 3-coin commission offsets a bid but never articulates the specific mechanism that commission is applied before payment or that payments allow bids above available coins. The transcript shows no rule or outcome where an overbid is permitted or commission ordering creates that effect.

The focal player repeatedly notes others are committed but also states sealed rival bids remain private; they do not claim or demonstrate that waiting reveals rival bid VALUES prior to committing, and the observations show no revealed rival values.

The focal player closes claiming unresolved lot should settle, but the model never demonstrates an observed early settlement or a rule discrepancy (trace shows no early settlement). The player’s statement contradicts the stated rule that close applies after all lots are sold, so no correct mechanism discovery is articulated or observed.

The focal text explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins and does not claim catalog purchases receive the auction commission. There is no evidence in the transcript of commissions being applied to catalog buys.
